I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June and that I hadn't changed anything, since she said no action was needed.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in that channel, so repeating it there was fine. I didn't read #north-team, edit any files or post anywhere else. Her earlier message with the wrong date is still in #north-team, and I can't correct it for her.
